blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Marcos’ decision to certify as urgent a bill that would facilitate a sustainable reintegration program for overseas Filipino workers (OFWs) would prepare the government for any kind of eventuality, Albay Rep. Adrian Salceda said. Salceda shared with reporters a copy of Marcos’ letter to Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian informing the latter that he has certified the necessity of immediate approval and enactment of Senate Bill (SB) No. 2423, or the proposed Bagong Balikbayan Act, meant to “provide vital intervention to the continuing and urgent need for sustained government assistance” to OFWs who are displaced. “Paglapag na paglapag […]...
